reviewedOrigins.apps/api/src/apps/projects/service/recon: the daily projects sweep: each org id is read from the database itself (an org with a project whose time and budgets switch is on, or with a time and budgets feature row), with moving orgs left out, and each org's recompute runs in writeUnlessMoving for that one org; it writes only that org's own feature row from that org's own projects

reviewedOutsideRoutes.apps/api/src/seed/tiers/minimal.ts#perso: the minimal seed tier's per-test entry point: no product code calls it; its only callers are test files, each on the org the test itself just created (createTestOrg), writing one message by that org's own person into that org's own thread
